sights.n: Trappistine Convent (天使の聖母トラピスチヌ修道院)
sights.w: Japan's first women's monastery — a 1927 Gothic-Romanesque brick church on the hills above Yunokawa, 35 minutes by bus from Hakodate Station.
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/天使の聖母トラピスチヌ修道院

sights.n: Seikan Ferry Memorial Ship Mashū-maru (函館市青函連絡船記念館摩周丸)
sights.w: A Seikan rail ferry retired in 1988 and moored as a museum 5 minutes from Hakodate Station — bridge and radio room kept as they sailed.
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/函館市青函連絡船記念館摩周丸

sights.n: Miura Ayako Memorial Literature Museum (三浦綾子記念文学館)
sights.w: In the 15-ha Foreign Tree Species forest where her novel Hyōten (Freezing Point) is set — with the restored study where the ailing Miura dictated her books.

sights.address: Tenninkyō, Higashikawa, Kamikawa District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A 270 m multi-step fall, one of Japan's celebrated waterfalls — a 15–20 minute trail from the end of the Tenninkyō Onsen road in Daisetsuzan.

sights.n: Niseko Village Ski Resort (ニセコビレッジ)
sights.address: Higashiyama, Niseko, Abuta District, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: The former Higashiyama area west of Hirafu — Hilton Niseko Village at the base and a forest course weaving through native woods; linked to Hirafu and Annupuri at the summit.

sights.n: Niseko Annupuri International Ski Area (ニセコアンヌプリ国際スキー場)
sights.w: The quieter, gentler of Niseko's big three — wide beginner- and family-friendly runs, less crowded, on the All Mountain Pass.
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ニセコアンヌプリ国際スキー場

sights.n: Niseko Moiwa Ski Resort (ニセコモイワスキーリゾート)
sights.w: A small independent fourth resort west of Annupuri — off the All Mountain Pass, so uncrowded and loved by powder purists and beginners.
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/ニセコモイワスキーリゾート
